items_flat.title_en: Anthropic and Accenture each pledge $1B for embedded frontier evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 與 Accenture 各承諾 10 億美元做嵌入式前沿評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced a partnership with Accenture (led by Faculty) to evaluate and red-team its frontier models, run alignment assessments, and test safeguards. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years. Anthropic said embedded evaluators will work inside the lab with employee-like access, that the arrangement is non-exclusive, and that it is also talking with METR and other nonprofits.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布與 Accenture（由 Faculty 主導）合作，對其前沿模型做評估、紅隊、對齊評估與防護測試。雙方預計五年各投入至少 10 億美元。公司稱嵌入式評估者將在實驗室內部、擁有接近員工的存取權；合作非獨家，並正與 METR 等非營利機構對話。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the most concrete follow-through yet of Amodei’s “pace the frontier” call: money and an inside seat, not another external audit PDF. The open question is independence—Anthropic is directly funding Accenture, a commercial partner—until pooled or public funding exists.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Amodei「放慢前沿節奏」主張目前最具體的落地：真金白銀與內部席位，而不只是外部報告。關鍵不確定性是獨立性——在公共資金到位前，評估費用由 Anthropic 直接支付給商業夥伴 Accenture。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic and Accenture each expect to invest at least $1 billion in building capacity in this area over the next five years.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 與 Accenture 預計未來五年各投入至少 10 億美元，建立此領域的評估能量。

items_flat.title_en: Plugin4Shell: zero-click RCE across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI
items_flat.title_zh: Plugin4Shell：零點擊 RCE 影響 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Gemini CLI
items_flat.summary_en: AIR Security disclosed Plugin4Shell, a SHA-pinning bypass that can make coding agents install attacker-controlled plugin code while appearing to honor a reviewed commit. Anthropic patched Claude Code in 2.1.179 and OpenAI patched Codex in 0.146.0. Reporting said Microsoft had not yet patched Copilot and Google would not patch deprecated Gemini CLI, directing users to Antigravity. No CVE or confirmed in-the-wild exploitation was listed at disclosure.
items_flat.summary_zh: AIR Security 揭露 Plugin4Shell：可繞過 SHA pinning，讓編碼代理在看似安裝已審核 commit 時載入攻擊者程式碼。Anthropic 於 Claude Code 2.1.179、OpenAI 於 Codex 0.146.0 修復。報導指 Microsoft 尚未修 Copilot，Google 不修已棄用的 Gemini CLI、改請用戶遷移 Antigravity。披露時未列 CVE，也無已知實戰利用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story is the plugin marketplace layer, not a model jailbreak. Pinning was the control enterprises trusted; until Copilot is patched and remaining Gemini CLI installs are retired, that control is incomplete.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點在外掛供應鏈，不是模型越獄。企業依賴的 pinning 假設被打破；在 Copilot 修補、殘留 Gemini CLI 退役前，這層控制並不完整。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters: Anthropic weighs a new model before IPO to answer GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.title_zh: 路透：Anthropic 評估在 IPO 前推出新模型以回應 GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, citing three sources, reported Anthropic is considering releasing a new model to counter OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra traction ahead of an expected IPO. Sources said Astra accounts for about 13% of enterprise AI spend tracked by Ramp versus 8% for Claude Fable, and that IPO marketing could slip until after the November U.S. midterms. Anthropic did not announce a model.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透引述三名消息人士稱，Anthropic 正考慮在預期 IPO 前推出新模型，以回應 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 的企業採用。消息指 Ramp 追蹤的企業 AI 支出中 Astra 約佔 13%、Claude Fable 約 8%；IPO 路演也可能延至美國 11 月期中選舉後。Anthropic 尚未宣布新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is competitive pressure, not a ship date. It sits uneasily next to Amodei’s public slowdown argument: any pre-IPO launch would have to be justified as a safety-cleared product, not just a market reply.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是競爭壓力，不是發布日。它與 Amodei 公開呼籲放慢節奏並存：若真在 IPO 前出貨，必須證明是通過安全評估的產品，而不只是市場回應。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic is considering rolling out a new AI model to counter OpenAI’s momentum since its launch of GPT-6 Astra, according to three sources.
items_flat.quote_zh: 據三名消息人士，Anthropic 正考慮推出新模型，以回應 OpenAI 自 GPT-6 Astra 發布後的動能。

items_flat.title_en: The Verge profiles METR, Redwood, and Apollo as labs’ default independent auditors
items_flat.title_zh: The Verge 專文：METR、Redwood、Apollo 成為大廠默認獨立審計方
items_flat.summary_en: The Verge published a reported profile of METR, Redwood Research, and Apollo Research, arguing recent OpenAI and Anthropic misalignment incidents have pushed the three nonprofits into the role of go-to independent auditors. The piece describes constrained access during the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident review and the labs’ growing public commitments to employee-like evaluator access.
items_flat.summary_zh: The Verge 刊出 METR、Redwood Research、Apollo Research 專文，指近期 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的錯位事件，使這三家非營利機構成為大廠最常找的獨立審計方。文中描述 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件調查時的存取限制，以及各實驗室逐漸承諾給予接近員工的評估權限。
items_flat.analysis_en: The auditors are now part of the product story, not a side beat. What remains unsettled is whether “embedded” access will be standardized—or stay a negotiated, lab-by-lab privilege.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 獨立審計已進入產品主線，不再是配角。尚未解決的是「嵌入式」存取會否變成共通標準，或仍是各實驗室逐案談判的特權。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes an Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布《澳洲青少年安全藍圖》
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an Australian Youth Safety Blueprint describing six pillars for teen AI use, including literacy, age-appropriate safeguards, privacy-protective age assurance, crisis-support links, and parental controls. It said ChatGPT for Teens began rolling out in Australia in August as the default for users identified as 13–17.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布《澳洲青少年安全藍圖》，提出六根支柱：AI 素養、適齡防護、保護隱私的年齡確認、危機支援連結與家長控制。公司表示 8 月已在澳洲開始將 ChatGPT for Teens 作為 13–17 歲用戶的預設體驗。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is policy positioning in a jurisdiction that has already forced age rules on platforms. It is a framework and a product default, not new model capability; enforcement details and how age assurance performs in practice remain the test.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是在已對平台強制年齡規範的司法管轄區做政策卡位。它是框架與產品預設，不是新模型能力；真正考驗仍是執行細節與年齡確認實務表現。
items_flat.quote: We are introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a roadmap for protecting young people as they use AI and a practical contribution to the Australian policy landscape.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出《澳洲青少年安全藍圖》，作為保護年輕人使用 AI 的路線圖，並對澳洲政策討論提出實務貢獻。

items_flat.title_en: xAI releases Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 at unchanged price
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，價格不變
items_flat.summary_en: xAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, a speech-to-text model it says is twice as accurate as 1.0 on its real-world tests and ranks first among 32 streaming models on an Artificial Analysis public leaderboard. Features include timestamps, diarization, multilingual transcription, multichannel audio, and smarter turn detection. Pricing stays $0.10/hour batch and $0.20/hour streaming; 1.0 remains available.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 發布語音轉文字模型 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，稱在自有實測上準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，並在 Artificial Analysis 32 個串流模型公開榜上排名第一。功能含時間戳、說話人分離、多語、多聲道與更佳輪次偵測。價格維持批次每小時 0.10 美元、串流每小時 0.20 美元；1.0 仍可用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a speech stack upgrade, not the delayed Grok 4.7/4.8 frontier text models. Same price plus a claimed accuracy jump is the commercial pitch; independent replication of the leaderboard claim is still the check.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是語音堆疊升級，不是延遲中的 Grok 4.7/4.8 前沿文字模型。同價加宣稱準確度翻倍是商業賣點；公開榜數字仍待獨立覆核。
items_flat.quote: Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在我們的真實場景評估中，Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 是目前最準確的轉寫模型之一，準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，價格相同。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says Claude now leads 26% of its model R&D tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 稱 Claude 已主導其 26% 模型研發任務
items_flat.summary_en: AP reported Anthropic said Claude is leading 26% of the company’s model research and development, completing most of a given task end-to-end from a high-level prompt under human supervision, and collaborating on about 90% of R&D. The company said the model is not yet working fully autonomously. The note landed the same week as Amodei’s slowdown comments.
items_flat.summary_zh: 美聯社報導 Anthropic 表示，Claude 已主導公司 26% 的模型研發，能在人類監督下從高階提示端到端完成多數任務，並參與約 90% 研發工作。公司強調模型尚未完全自主。此訊息與 Amodei 呼籲放慢節奏落在同一週。
items_flat.analysis_en: If the 26% figure holds, internal automation is already a production fact, not a demo. That raises a measurement problem the lab itself has been pushing: outsiders still cannot see how much of the next model is model-built.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若 26% 數字成立，內部自動化已是產線事實而非展示。這正好碰到該實驗室自己在談的度量問題：外界仍看不到下一版模型有多少是模型自己做的。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 changes TUI reasoning-summary default
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 調整 TUI 推理摘要預設
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI shipped Codex 0.155.1, which disables reasoning summaries by default in new local TUI sessions so providers that reject those requests no longer fail the session. Explicit reasoning-summary settings are still honored. The prior 0.155.0 line had added experimental voice conversations and live reasoning summaries.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 釋出 Codex 0.155.1：新的本機 TUI 工作階段預設關閉推理摘要，避免不支援該功能的供應商直接拒請求。使用者若明確設定仍會生效。前一版 0.155.0 才剛加入實驗性語音對話與即時推理摘要。
items_flat.analysis_en: A compatibility patch, not a model launch. It shows how fast the Codex agent surface is moving—and how provider differences still break local sessions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是相容性修補，不是模型發表。可見 Codex 代理介面迭代很快，供應商差異仍會讓本機工作階段直接失敗。

frontier_other.summary_zh: The Verge 刊出 METR、Redwood Research、Apollo Research 專文，指近期 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的錯位事件，使這三家非營利機構成為大廠最常找的獨立審計方。文中描述 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件調查時的存取限制，以及各實驗室逐漸承諾給予接近員工的評估權限。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The auditors are now part of the product story, not a side beat. What remains unsettled is whether “embedded” access will be standardized—or stay a negotiated, lab-by-lab privilege.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 獨立審計已進入產品主線，不再是配角。尚未解決的是「嵌入式」存取會否變成共通標準，或仍是各實驗室逐案談判的特權。

brief_en: Quiet overnight. The live picture is safety and tooling: Anthropic funds embedded evaluation with Accenture, Reuters says it may ship a new model before IPO, Plugin4Shell hit four coding agents, OpenAI published an Australian youth-safety blueprint, and xAI shipped Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0.
brief_zh: 週日凌晨相對平靜。主軸是安全與工具：Anthropic 與 Accenture 投入嵌入式評估、路透稱其可能在 IPO 前出新模型、Plugin4Shell 影響四大編碼代理、OpenAI 發布澳洲青少年安全藍圖、xAI 推出 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0。
